Privacy Policy

Read the RT Signature Homes privacy policy to learn what personal data we collect, how we use and share it, how long we keep it, and your privacy rights.

1. Who We Are

Our website address is: https://rtsignaturehomes.com/

RT Signature Homes Design & Build - Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly.

2. What Personal Data We Collect and Why

Comments

If visitors leave comments on our website, we collect the information provided in the comments form, along with the visitor's IP address and browser user agent string to help detect spam and protect our website.

Media

If you upload images to our website, we recommend removing embedded location data (EXIF GPS) before uploading. Visitors may be able to download images and extract location information embedded within them.

Contact Forms

When you contact us through our website, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, and any information included in your message. We use this information to respond to inquiries, provide information about our kitchen and bathroom remodeling services, prepare estimates, and communicate with you about your project.

We do not use your contact information for marketing communications without your consent where required by applicable law.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies to improve functionality and user experience. Cookies may remember your preferences, support website security, assist with login functionality, and help us understand how visitors use our website.

If you leave a comment, cookies may save your name, email address, and website for convenience. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings, although some website features may not function properly as a result.

Embedded Content

Our website may include embedded content from third-party websites, such as videos, maps, or other media. Embedded content behaves in the same way as if you visited the third-party website directly.

These third-party websites may collect information about you, use cookies, track your interactions with their content, and process your information according to their own privacy policies.

Analytics

We may use third-party analytics services, such as Google Analytics, to understand how visitors interact with our website and improve its performance. These services may collect information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and time spent on our website.

The information collected through analytics is used to evaluate website traffic and improve our online services, subject to the applicable privacy settings and legal requirements.

3. Who We Share Your Data With

We may share personal information with third-party service providers when necessary to operate our website and provide our services, including:

  • Google Analytics: To analyze website traffic and visitor behavior, if analytics services are enabled.
  • Spam detection services: To identify and prevent spam, fraudulent activity, and malicious submissions.
  • Email and communication providers: To receive and respond to customer inquiries and manage communications.
  • Email marketing platforms: If you subscribe to marketing communications and such services are used.

We may also disclose information when required by law or when necessary to protect our rights, website, customers, or business.

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

4. How Long We Retain Your Data

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and protect our business interests.

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata may be retained indefinitely to help recognize and approve follow-up comments.

If you submit a contact form or request an estimate, we may retain your information for as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry, manage your project, maintain business records, and meet applicable legal requirements.

If user registration is available on our website, personal information provided in user profiles will be retained while the account remains active or as otherwise required by law.

5. What Rights You Have Over Your Data

Depending on your location and applicable privacy laws, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to the personal information we hold about you.
  • Request a copy of your personal information.
  • Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Request deletion of your personal information.
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
  • Object to or request restrictions on certain types of processing, where applicable.

These rights are subject to applicable legal requirements and exceptions, including information we must retain for legal, administrative, security, or legitimate business purposes.

To submit a privacy request, please contact us using the details provided below.

6. Where We Send Your Data

Visitor comments and form submissions may be checked through automated spam detection or security services. Information may also be processed by third-party service providers that help us operate our website, analyze traffic, and manage communications.

These providers may process information on our behalf in accordance with their own privacy policies, contractual obligations, and applicable data protection laws.

7. Contact Information

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to make a request regarding your personal information, please contact us:
